The '''Comet Run''' was a racing event that took place in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The event was often attended by the citizens of [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]].

==History==
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Racer from Pika Oasis|racer]] from Pika Oasis was a competitor in the race.
